description: Run your movie collection in Radarr from workflows: add movies from requests, forms or watchlists, look up and list movies, search, refresh, tag and delete them, get upcoming releases for a digest, and see missing movies, the download queue, history, health and disk space. Start a workflow when a movie is downloaded, grabbed or added, or Radarr reports a health issue.

radarr_health_issue_trigger.description: Runs when Radarr's health check reports a new warning or error, such as an indexer or download client it can't reach or a missing root folder. Issues already there when the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: Warnings and errors, or errors only. Leave blank for warnings and errors.
parameters.name: level

radarr_movie_added_trigger.description: Runs when a movie is added to Radarr's library, by a person, an import list or another app, with its details. Movies already there when the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: Only movies added with this tag. Leave blank for every movie.
parameters.name: tag

radarr_movie_downloaded_trigger.description: Runs when Radarr imports a finished download into the library, with the movie, its quality and where the file went. Downloads from before the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: Only this movie in Radarr's library, by title or its ID in Radarr. Leave blank for every movie.
parameters.name: movie

radarr_movie_grabbed_trigger.description: Runs when Radarr sends a release to the download client, with the movie, the release, its quality and where it was found, such as to tell whoever asked for it that it's on its way.

parameters.description: Only this movie in Radarr's library, by title or its ID in Radarr. Leave blank for every movie.
parameters.name: movie
